name: ideapulse-root
description: BusinessListe - Community Idea Validation and Rating Platform

scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.build: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "blue,magenta" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.dev:local: TURSO_DATABASE_URL= TURSO_AUTH_TOKEN= NODE_ENV=development CLIENT_URL=http://localhost:5173 DATABASE_PATH=./src/db/local-test.db npm run dev
scripts.seed:local: TURSO_DATABASE_URL= TURSO_AUTH_TOKEN= NODE_ENV=development CLIENT_URL=http://localhost:5173 DATABASE_PATH=./src/db/local-test.db npm run seed
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
